text: Level two, question three: pipe A fills a tank in twelve hours and pipe B in fifteen hours; with a third pipe C also open, the tank fills in five hours; how long would C alone take, and does it fill or empty? Question four: pipe A fills a tank twice as fast as pipe B, and together they fill it in twenty minutes; how long would each take alone? Question five: two inlets deliver twelve and eighteen litres a minute, and an outlet removes ten litres a minute; how long will they take to fill an empty nine hundred litre tank?
